Overview: UniFi Access Hub 4.9.14.0 includes the following improvements and bugfixes.
Improvements: Optimized door unlocking response time.
Supports 2-Step Authentication.
Enable it in Access application > Devices > select Reader > Settings > Access Methods > 2-Step Authentication and select Require Two Methods or Require Approver.
Requirements:
Access application 3.2.42 or later
G3 Intercom 1.7.29 or later
UA Intercom 1.7.28 or later
G3 Pro 1.10.30 or later
G2 Pro 1.10.32 or later
Bugfixes: Fixed an issue with time synchronization that could prevent door unlocking.
Fixed a potential issue that could cause the UA Hub to run out of memory and go offline.
Fixed an issue where the UA Hub failed to maintain the emergency evacuation mode if it was activated during the unlock duration following successful authentication.

releases.html:
Overview

UniFi Access Hub 4.9.14.0 includes the following improvements and bugfixes.

Improvements

  • Optimized door unlocking response time. 
  • Supports 2-Step Authentication. 
  • Enable it in Access application > Devices > select Reader > Settings > Access Methods > 2-Step Authentication and select Require Two Methods or Require Approver.
  • Requirements:
  • Access application 3.2.42 or later
  • G3 Intercom 1.7.29 or later
  • UA Intercom 1.7.28 or later
  • G3 Pro 1.10.30 or later
  • G2 Pro 1.10.32 or later

Bugfixes

  • Fixed an issue with time synchronization that could prevent door unlocking.
  • Fixed a potential issue that could cause the UA Hub to run out of memory and go offline.
  • Fixed an issue where the UA Hub failed to maintain the emergency evacuation mode if it was activated during the unlock duration following successful authentication.

Bugfixes: Fixed network congestion in version 4.8.3.0 caused by network monitoring in large domain environments, which previously led to device offline issues and unlock failures.

Overview: UA Hub 4.4.5.0 fixes several issues related to PoE, door opening detection, rare device crashes, and Leave Unlocked mode.
Bugfixes: Fixed the PoE output power drop issue during UA Hub restart. (UA Hub Door is not affected by this issue.)
Fixed the issue where Leave Unlocked mode ending could interfere with door state set by other modes, e.g., evacuation.
[Identity Enterprise] Fixed the issue where the device incorrectly reported the following events to Identity Enterprise as unauthorized door openings:
The door was opened after being unlocked remotely.
The door was opened during Emergency Evacuation mode.
Fixed the following issues caused by the device crash:
Users could not unlock doors within a brief timeframe.
The device update initially failed but was successful upon retrying.

releases.html:
Overview

UA Hub 4.4.5.0 fixes several issues related to PoE, door opening detection, rare device crashes, and Leave Unlocked mode. 

Bugfixes

  • Fixed the PoE output power drop issue during UA Hub restart. (UA Hub Door is not affected by this issue.)
  • Fixed the issue where Leave Unlocked mode ending could interfere with door state set by other modes, e.g., evacuation.
  • [Identity Enterprise] Fixed the issue where the device incorrectly reported the following events to Identity Enterprise as unauthorized door openings:
  • The door was opened after being unlocked remotely.
  • The door was opened during Emergency Evacuation mode.
  • Fixed the following issues caused by the device crash:
  • Users could not unlock doors within a brief timeframe.
  • The device update initially failed but was successful upon retrying.

Improvements: Adjusted the total PoE power budget limit to 45W.
The Emergency mode can take immediate effect upon activation (requires Access application 1.21.8 or later).
Updates on users, visitors, NFC cards, and door access policies can be synced to the device immediately (requires Access application 1.21.4 or later).

Always keep doors locked. Users can only unlock doors remotely or by using a physical button.
Topology

Bugfixes: Fixed the issue where the doors were sometimes unlocked automatically.
Fixed the issue where doors sometimes could not be unlocked.
Known issues: Updating UA Hubs may sometimes fail. Update failures are not system-threatening. When this occurs, please attempt the update again.

Overview: UA Hub 4.1.3.8 enables admins to set the AUX DRY mode and the AUX POWERED mode separately, has optimized the UA Hub’s removal and LED behaviors, and has fixed issues associated with door unlock and emergency mode.
Improvements: AUX Behavior
Added support for setting the AUX DRY mode and the AUX POWERED mode separately (requires the UniFi Access application v1.5.10 or later).
The DRY Port can be set to three modes:
Door Opener (Default)
Alarm
Chime
The POWERED Port can be set to two modes:
Alarm
Chime (Default)
When the AUX is in Alarm mode, an alarm will be triggered if a door is left open for too long.
Device Removal
Removing a UA Hub from the Access application will also reset the hub.
LED
Optimized the device’s LED behavior.
Bugfixes: Door Unlock
Fixed an issue where doors sometimes could not be unlocked.
Settings
Fixed the issue where the emergency evacuation mode could not be switched to the emergency lockdown mode.

releases.html:
Overview

UA Hub 4.1.3.8 enables admins to set the AUX DRY mode and the AUX POWERED mode separately, has optimized the UA Hub’s removal and LED behaviors, and has fixed issues associated with door unlock and emergency mode.

Improvements

AUX Behavior

  • Added support for setting the AUX DRY mode and the AUX POWERED mode separately (requires the UniFi Access application v1.5.10 or later).
  • The DRY Port can be set to three modes:
  • Door Opener (Default)
  • Alarm
  • Chime
  • The POWERED Port can be set to two modes:
  • Alarm
  • Chime (Default)
  • When the AUX is in Alarm mode, an alarm will be triggered if a door is left open for too long.

Device Removal

  • Removing a UA Hub from the Access application will also reset the hub.

LED

  • Optimized the device’s LED behavior.

Bugfixes

Door Unlock

  • Fixed an issue where doors sometimes could not be unlocked.

Settings

  • Fixed the issue where the emergency evacuation mode could not be switched to the emergency lockdown mode.

Improvements: Support wiring chimes to UA-Hub.
Support setting DPS input terminal in the UniFi Access application.
Additional information: 1. For wiring chimes to UA-Hub, we provide two methods for different scenarios:
Scenario 1: You have installed one UA-Pro outdoor and one chime indoor, and you want the chime inside to ring when someone makes a call on UA-Pro:
Launch your UniFi Access application.
Click Devices and select a hub. A panel showing the hub details will appear.
Click Ports.
Scroll down to AUX Mode and select Doorbell Mode.
Click Save.
Scenario 2: You have installed the chime indoors, and you want the chime inside to ring when someone presses the doorbell push button outside.
Launch your UniFi Access application.
Click Devices and select a hub. A panel showing the hub details will appear.
Click Ports.
Scroll down to AUX Mode and select Doorbell Mode.
Scroll down to REN Mode and select Doorbell Mode.
Click Save.
2. To set the DPS input terminal, follow the steps below:
Launch your UniFi Access application.
Go to Devices.
Select a UA-Hub and click Ports.
Scroll down to the Input Terminal section.
Select High Active NO or Low Active NC from the DPS dropdown menu.

releases.html:
Improvements

  • Support wiring chimes to UA-Hub.
  • Support setting DPS input terminal in the UniFi Access application. 

Additional information

1. For wiring chimes to UA-Hub, we provide two methods for different scenarios:

  • Scenario 1: You have installed one UA-Pro outdoor and one chime indoor, and you want the chime inside to ring when someone makes a call on UA-Pro:
  1. Launch your UniFi Access application.
  2. Click Devices and select a hub. A panel showing the hub details will appear.
  3. Click Ports.
  4. Scroll down to AUX Mode and select Doorbell Mode.
  5. Click Save.
  • Scenario 2: You have installed the chime indoors, and you want the chime inside to ring when someone presses the doorbell push button outside. 
  1. Launch your UniFi Access application.
  2. Click Devices and select a hub. A panel showing the hub details will appear.
  3. Click Ports.
  4. Scroll down to AUX Mode and select Doorbell Mode.
  5. Scroll down to REN Mode and select Doorbell Mode.
  6. Click Save.

2. To set the DPS input terminal, follow the steps below:

  1. Launch your UniFi Access application.
  2. Go to Devices.
  3. Select a UA-Hub and click Ports.
  4. Scroll down to the Input Terminal section.
  5. Select High Active NO or Low Active NC from the DPS dropdown menu.

AUX Mode was set to Door Opener Mode.
